industry_sources.title: Amazon Forecast: new-product metadata matching
industry_sources.date_note: Official What’s New post; follow-up walkthrough dated 2022-11-21. Same capability, not separate methods.
industry_sources.summary: Forecast a never-sold product from similar products and item attributes.
strengths: Metadata selects related historical donor products.
limitations: Proprietary backend; no reusable matched public evaluation supplied.
Current Forecast API docs say unavailable to new customers.
industry_sources.horizon: User-defined; no matched public N0 comparison
industry_sources.locator: Announcement paragraphs 1-4; Walkthrough: Import your training data; Train a predictor
industry_sources.business_evidence: Inventory-planning motivation; no attributable measured dollars.

industry_sources.title: Price optimization notebook for apparel retail using Google Vertex AI
industry_sources.date_note: Date displayed in official Google Cloud article. Earliest family appearance not exhaustively traced.
industry_sources.summary: Share demand patterns across products using their attributes, then explore pricing decisions.
strengths: Runnable-reference link and explicit transfer across SKU attributes.
Connects forecasts to pricing and inventory constraints.
limitations: Limited-history support only partly addressed by reference implementation.
No matched N0 leaderboard result or measured causal profit.
The article demonstrates synthetic data for 400 SKUs, not an evaluated real new-product cohort.
Notebook example uses 28 days of context; zero-history accuracy is not evaluated.
industry_sources.horizon: User-defined; no matched public N0 comparison
industry_sources.locator: Demand Forecasting Model > Preparing the Training Data; Limitations and Caveats > Historical data availability
industry_sources.business_evidence: Profit optimization demonstration, not measured deployment uplift.

industry_sources.title: GEANN: Scalable Graph Augmentations for Multi-Horizon Time Series Forecasting
industry_sources.date_note: arXiv v1 submission date; earliest verified public version.
industry_sources.summary: Use relationships between products to improve demand forecasts for newly launched items.
strengths: Industrial evaluation includes over two million products.
Newly launched and stockout cohorts reported separately.
limitations: Launch-age bound unresolved; stockout cohort is not new-item evidence.
Industrial data not verified downloadable; learned kNN graph can degrade results.
industry_sources.horizon: Weekly demand quantiles up to one-year horizon
industry_sources.version: KDD 2023 Workshop on Deep Learning on Graphs
industry_sources.locator: Section 3 Results: inputs and time split; Section 3.2 Newly launched and Recently Out-Of-Stock Products; Table 3
industry_sources.business_evidence: Forecast accuracy study; no causal monetary impact established.

industry_sources.title: Demand forecasting at Getir built with Amazon Forecast
industry_sources.date_note: Date on official AWS customer-authored post.
industry_sources.summary: Getir uses Amazon Forecast for daily SKU planning and discusses new-item forecasting.
strengths: Reports an operating forecasting pipeline at grocery scale.
Describes CNN-QR choice and metadata use.
limitations: System-wide commercial outcomes cannot be attributed to cold-start forecasting alone.
industry_sources.business_evidence: Vendor/customer-reported overall revenue and waste changes; no new-item attribution or measured dollar amount.
